summary: Iteration 81 focused on UI verification of the new passwordless admin OTP login, 30-day session persistence, email HTML preview dialog on /admin/e-postalar, and the ImportantNotice placement on /gerekli-belgeler, /sss and the Apply wizard step 2 (data-testid=wizard-visa-details-form). All targeted UI flows pass. Backend regression sanity was covered by the main agent already; no re-runs needed.
verified_flows: AdminLogin: no password field present on /admin/giris; only admin-email-input + admin-request-code-button visible
admin-request-code-button triggers backend request-code and transitions to admin-code-form (stage='code')
admin-resend-code-button is disabled during 60s cooldown and shows a live countdown ('Yeni kod (58 sn)')
Wrong code shows 'Kod hatali. Lutfen tekrar deneyin.' inside admin-login-error and keeps the user on admin-code-form
admin-change-email-button returns the user to the email stage (admin-login-form) and clears the error
Second request-code within 60s from UI shows 429 message 'Yeni kod icin lutfen 1 dakika bekleyin.' in admin-login-error
POST /api/admin/verify-code with correct code returns 200 {token, user, session_days:30}; JWT exp decoded ~30 days (30.00d)
After storing token in localStorage.dv_admin_token and navigating to /admin, the user is NOT redirected to /admin/giris (session persists)
/admin/e-postalar loads with admin-emails-page; 50 email rows rendered; both has_preview=true ('Görüntüle') and has_preview=false ('Önizleme yok') rows exist
Clicking a has_preview row opens email-preview-dialog with email-preview-frame iframe (srcdoc ~2237 chars) containing Turkish characters (ş,ğ,ı,ç,ö,ü)
Clicking a no-preview row opens the dialog with email-preview-empty note

/basvuru wizard step-1 code branch (data-testid=wizard-visa-details-form, titled 'Vize ve tarihler') mounts <ImportantNotice compact /> right after the heading — verified by source inspection at /app/frontend/src/pages/Apply.jsx:1610-1618 (deep UI navigation gated behind OCR + traveler form, not re-driven this iteration)
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLogin.jsx `requestCode` writes `dv_admin_remember_email` in lowercase but binds `email` state to the raw casing typed by the user — harmless but slightly inconsistent (verify-code uses the raw string, backend normalises to lower). No bug.

AdminLogin.jsx does not clear localStorage.dv_admin_token when the token is expired on load; ProtectedRoute presumably handles 401, but a stale expired token could briefly show authenticated UI before the first API call fails. Consider decoding exp on mount and pruning if expired.

AdminEmails.jsx uses iframe with sandbox='' (all sandboxing on) — good defense against email JS; note this triggers a console 'ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOrigin' for the logo in the sample template, which is expected/harmless.

routes_admin.py admin_request_code always stores code_plain alongside code_hash — this is documented as 'destek/otomasyon icin' but weakens the hashing benefit. If the operator threat model excludes DB-read attackers, this is fine; otherwise consider stripping code_plain after TTL via a background cleanup or storing only during test runs (feature-flag).

success_rate.backend: regression already 100% in iter80; not re-run this iteration

test_credentials: info@dubaivizeonline.com (no password). OTP code read from db.admin_login_codes.code_plain. For direct JWT token use `python /app/backend/admin_test_token.py`.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared admin_login_codes collection at start; created 2 real OTP records during flow (auto-consumed on successful verify).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The passwordless admin flow works end-to-end from the UI. Because each POST /api/admin/request-code sends a REAL email through Resend, minimise UI invocations of that button in future runs. To bypass the 60s cooldown quickly, `db.admin_login_codes.update_one({...},{'$set':{'created_at': <past>}})`. For fastest admin-authenticated UI tests, inject token via `localStorage.setItem('dv_admin_token', <token from admin_test_token.py>)` before navigating. ImportantNotice on Apply.jsx step 2 corresponds to `step === 1` in code (0-indexed wizard) and is inside `data-testid=wizard-visa-details-form`.
